title: Practice Deck: The Calm Morning Method

slides.title: The Calm Morning Method
slides.subtitle: How to start your day before your phone does
slides.body: A 20-minute practice for coaches who wake up already behind.
slides.notes: Welcome everyone. Take one slow breath with me before we start.

slides.title: Who this is for
bullets: You check email before you get out of bed
Your best ideas show up at 11pm, when you're too tired to use them
You've tried morning routines and **quit by day four**
slides.notes: Ask for a show of hands on the first bullet.

slides.title: If all I did today was give you **one quiet hour back**, would that be worth it?
slides.notes: Pause. Let them answer in the chat.

slides.title: The 3 beliefs we're going to shift

cards.title: Old: I need more time
cards.body: New: I need my first 20 minutes back

cards.title: Old: Routines are rigid
cards.body: New: One anchor habit is enough

cards.title: Old: I'm not a morning person
cards.body: New: Mornings are a skill, not a trait

slides.notes: Read each old belief out loud, then flip it.

slides.title: Your next step
slides.body: Join the group before Friday and the workbook is yours free.
slides.notes: Drop the link in the chat now.

slides.title: Thank you
slides.body: Questions? Stay on for the live Q&A.
